launch_destination.title: Rocket can reach the orbit
launch_destination.fail: The {vehicle} cannot fly to {orbit}. Each rocket can only reach certain destinations.
launch_destination.fixHint: Pick a rocket that lists a capacity for {destination}.

launch_capacity.title: Rocket can lift the spacecraft
launch_capacity.pass: {totalKg} kg on a rocket that lifts {capKg} kg to this orbit ({launchMargin}% margin).
launch_capacity.warn: Only {launchMargin}% margin ({totalKg} of {capKg} kg). Spacecraft usually get heavier during development.
launch_capacity.fail: Too heavy: {totalKg} kg, but the {vehicle} lifts only {capKg} kg to this orbit.
launch_capacity.fixHint: Choose a bigger rocket, a lighter bus, fewer instruments, or a more efficient engine (less propellant).

bus_mass.title: Bus can carry the load
bus_mass.pass: {totalKg} kg is within the {busName}'s {busMaxKg} kg limit.
bus_mass.warn: {totalKg} kg is close to the {busName}'s {busMaxKg} kg limit.
bus_mass.fail: The {busName} is rated for {busMaxKg} kg but the spacecraft weighs {totalKg} kg.
bus_mass.fixHint: Pick a bigger bus or remove mass.

bus_slots.title: Room for instruments
bus_slots.fail: {instrCount} instruments, but the {busName} has only {slots} slots.
bus_slots.fixHint: Remove an instrument or choose a bigger bus.

power_balance.title: Enough power
power_balance.pass: Arrays give {genW} W on average; the spacecraft uses {loadW} W ({powerMargin}% margin).
power_balance.warn: Only {powerMargin}% power margin. Solar arrays lose power every year in space.
power_balance.fail: The spacecraft needs {loadW} W but the arrays average only {genW} W.
power_balance.fixHint: Add solar array watts, switch to GaAs panels, or remove power-hungry instruments.

battery_eclipse.title: Battery lasts through the shadow
battery_eclipse.warn: The {eclipseMin}-minute eclipse needs {batteryReqWh} Wh; you have {batteryWh} Wh. Instruments will switch off in the shadow.
battery_eclipse.fail: The battery ({batteryWh} Wh) is far too small for the {eclipseMin}-minute eclipse ({batteryReqWh} Wh needed).
battery_eclipse.fixHint: Raise battery capacity to at least {batteryReqWh} Wh.

deltav_capability.title: Enough delta-v
deltav_capability.pass: The engine provides {dvCapability} m/s for the {dvRequired} m/s this mission needs.
deltav_capability.warn: Only {dvCapability} of {dvRequired} m/s: the orbit is reachable but the mission will end early.
deltav_capability.fail: Reaching {orbit} takes {insertionDv} m/s, but the spacecraft can only provide {dvCapability} m/s.
deltav_capability.fixHint: Choose stronger propulsion (higher Isp needs less propellant) or raise the delta-v margin.

electric_power.title: Electric thrusters have power
electric_power.pass: The arrays can drive the electric thrusters.
electric_power.fail: Electric thrusters need at least 1,000 W from the arrays at this distance from the Sun.
electric_power.fixHint: Increase the solar array or choose chemical propulsion.

adcs_environment.title: Attitude control works here
adcs_environment.fail: Magnetorquers push against Earth's magnetic field, which is far too weak at {orbit}.

pointing_quality.title: Instruments pointed precisely
pointing_quality.warn: Blurred: {blurredList}. Your attitude control holds only ±{adcsDeg}°.
pointing_quality.fixHint: Choose a more precise attitude control system.

hga_pointing.title: Dish antenna can be aimed
hga_pointing.pass: The dish antenna can be aimed precisely.
hga_pointing.warn: The dish needs ±0.1° pointing; {adcsName} only gives ±{adcsDeg}°, so the dish does nothing.

radio_range.title: Radio can reach Earth
radio_range.fail: The {radio} through the {ground} cannot reach a spacecraft at {orbit}.
radio_range.fixHint: Beyond Earth orbit use the Deep-Space Network and an S, X or Ka-band radio.

data_return.title: Data gets home
data_return.pass: {downlink} Gbit/day of downlink for {generated} Gbit/day of data ({returnPct}% returned).
data_return.warn: Only {returnPct}% of the data can be sent home ({downlink} of {generated} Gbit/day).
data_return.fail: Almost nothing gets home: {returnPct}% ({downlink} of {generated} Gbit/day).
data_return.fixHint: Faster radio, a dish antenna, a bigger ground network, or the compression computer.

storage.title: Memory can buffer data
storage.warn: Data piles up faster than it can be sent; {storage} Gbit of memory fills within days.
storage.fixHint: Improve the downlink or choose the computer with more storage.

budget_total.title: Within budget
budget_total.warn: Only {reservePct}% reserve. Surprises during the mission may push you over.
budget_total.fail: Total cost {totalCost} is over the {budget} budget.
budget_total.fixHint: Cheaper rocket, fewer instruments, shorter mission or cheaper ground network.

role_allocation.title: {role} within allocation
role_allocation.fixHint: Request funds from another role, or cut costs in this role.

launch_window.title: Ready for the launch window
launch_window.pass: Ready at month {launchMonth}; the window is month {window}.
launch_window.warn: Development takes until month {launchMonth}, but the window is month {window}: {delayMonths} months of delay costing {delayCost}.
launch_window.fixHint: Fewer advanced parts and simpler instruments shorten development.

required_instruments.title: Mission objective covered
required_instruments.pass: Every required instrument type is on board.
required_instruments.fixHint: Science Lead: add an instrument with that capability.

lifetime_min.title: Mission long enough
lifetime_min.warn: {lifetime} years is shorter than the required {minLifetime} years.

debris_disposal.title: Clean end of life
debris_disposal.pass: {disposalDv} m/s is kept to dispose of the spacecraft.
debris_disposal.warn: No way to deorbit at end of life. Dead spacecraft in crowded orbits become dangerous debris.
debris_disposal.fixHint: Carry propulsion with enough delta-v for disposal.

natural_lifetime.title: Orbit lasts long enough
natural_lifetime.pass: The orbit is stable for the planned mission.
natural_lifetime.warn: Without propulsion this orbit lasts only about {naturalLife} years, less than the planned {lifetime}.
natural_lifetime.fixHint: Add propulsion or shorten the mission.
